t1.descripcion:
• La paella is a rice dish originally from Valencia. It contains rice, seafood, chicken and vegetables.
• La tortilla de patatas is a very common dish, made with eggs, potatoes and onion.
• El gazpacho is a cold soup of tomato, cucumber, pepper and garlic, typical of summer.
• El jamón ibérico is a very famous cured sausage, eaten in slices.
• Las tapas are small portions of food served in bars.
• Los churros con chocolate are a very popular sweet breakfast.
• El cocido madrileño is a stew of chickpeas, meat and vegetables.

📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: In Spain, the main meal is usually eaten at 14:00 and dinner at 21:00 or later. Tapas are eaten before dinner.
❌ COMMON MISTAKE: Chinese speakers often confuse "paella" with "paellera" (the pan). La paella is the dish; la paellera is the container.
ejemplos: La paella valenciana lleva arroz, pollo y mariscos.
Me encanta la tortilla de patatas con cebolla.
En verano, el gazpacho es muy refrescante.
El jamón ibérico se come en lonchas finas.
Vamos a un bar de tapas esta noche.

t2.descripcion:
• Los tacos al pastor are a Mexican dish of pork with pineapple and spices, served in tortillas.
• La arepa is a corn bread typical of Venezuela and Colombia, it can be eaten with cheese or meat.
• El ceviche is a Peruvian dish of raw fish marinated in lemon and ají.
• La empanada is a dough filled with meat, cheese or vegetables, typical of many countries.
• El asado is grilled meat, very popular in Argentina and Uruguay.
• El mole poblano is a complex Mexican sauce with chocolate and chiles.
• La feijoada is a stew of black beans and pork, typical of Brazil.

📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: In Latin America, the term "tortilla" can refer to a corn tortilla (flat) or to an egg tortilla (as in Spain). Context is key.
❌ COMMON MISTAKE: Chinese speakers often say "taco" to refer to any Mexican food, but there are many different dishes. Not all Mexican foods are tacos.
ejemplos: Los tacos al pastor llevan piña y carne de cerdo.
En Venezuela, la arepa se come en el desayuno.
El ceviche peruano es fresco y picante.
Las empanadas argentinas pueden ser de carne o de queso.
El asado argentino es famoso en todo el mundo.

t3.descripcion:
• Rice, wheat and corn are staple cereals in Hispanic gastronomy.
• The most used vegetables are tomato, onion, pepper, garlic and potato.
• Legumes include chickpeas, lentils and beans.
• The most common meats are chicken, pork, beef and fish.
• Dairy products such as milk, cheese and yogurt are frequent.
• Spices and herbs: salt, pepper, cumin, oregano, cilantro and parsley.
• Olive oil is fundamental in Spanish cuisine.

📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: In Spanish, "patata" is used in Spain, but in many Latin American countries "papa" is said. Both terms are correct.
❌ COMMON MISTAKE: Chinese speakers often confuse "pimiento" (辣椒) with "pimienta" (胡椒). Pimiento is the vegetable; pimienta is the spice.
ejemplos: El arroz es un ingrediente básico en la paella.
Sofríe la cebolla y el ajo en aceite de oliva.
Añade sal y pimienta al gusto.
En México se usa mucho el maíz.
El cilantro es una hierba muy aromática.

t4.descripcion:
• To give instructions in a recipe, verbs in the imperative (tú) are used: corta, añade, mezcla, cocina, sirve.
• First the ingredients are prepared: pelar, cortar, picar, lavar.
• Then it is cooked: freír, hervir, asar, cocer.
• The ingredients are added: añadir, echar, incorporar.
• It is mixed: mezclar, remover, batir.
• It is served: servir, emplatar, decorar.
• Example of a recipe: "Tortilla de patatas": 1. Pela y corta las patatas. 2. Fríe las patatas en aceite. 3. Bate los huevos. 4. Mezcla las patatas con los huevos. 5. Cocina la mezcla en una sartén. 6. Sirve caliente.

📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: In recipes, the imperative is used a lot, but the infinitive ("pelar", "cortar") or the present indicative ("pelamos", "cortamos") can also be used.
❌ COMMON MISTAKE: Chinese speakers often use the formal imperative (usted) in recipes, but the informal imperative (tú) or the infinitive is more common. For example, you say "corta" or "cortar", not "corte".
ejemplos: Pela las patatas y córtalas en rodajas.
Bate los huevos en un bol.
Añade una pizca de sal a la mezcla.
Fríe la tortilla por los dos lados.
Sirve la tortilla caliente y disfruta.

dict.塔帕斯：一种饮食和社交方式: Tapas: a way of eating and socializing
dict.在西班牙，塔帕斯是酒吧里供应的小份食物。人们从一个酒吧到另一个酒吧，点一份塔帕斯: In Spain, tapas are small portions of food served in bars. People go from bar to bar, ordering a tapa and a drink. It is a way to socialize and share. Tapas can be olives, ham, tortilla, etc. Each region has its typical tapas. For example, in the south, fried fish tapas are common, while in the north, it's skewers. Going to bars for tapas is a very fun traditional culture.
dict.在中国，人们也喜欢小吃，如包子、饺子或串串，但通常是坐在餐馆里吃，不像西班牙那样: In China, people also enjoy snacks such as baozi, dumplings or skewers, but they usually eat them sitting in restaurants, not standing and moving between bars as in Spain.

dict.汉语母语者常把 r 发成汉语的“日”或“l”。西班牙语的单 r（如 arroz: Native Chinese speakers often pronounce r as the Chinese 'r' or 'l'. The Spanish single r (like the first r in arroz) is a light trill, rr is a multiple trill. To practice, lightly touch the tip of your tongue to the alveolar ridge and let the air make it vibrate quickly.
